subject: Vendor portal proof-of-possession manifest & owner-mapping (Archer -> Vendr sync)
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Julie Smith <julie.smith@acmehealth.com>, Vendr Support <support@vendr.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2026 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor portal proof-of-possession manifest & owner-mapping (Archer -> Vendr sync)

Hi Julie —

Thanks again for the quick sync this morning. As we discussed, Acme's procurement team wants a compact proof-of-possession payload and an explicit mapping of resource owners before completing the portal enablement in Vendr. To keep this low-touch for your team, Redwood can provide: 

- A signed manifest of S3 object hashes (SHA256) for the artifacts requested in the CAIQ/SIG pick-list.
- A short verification script (Python) that can re-hash the objects and validate the manifest against a KMS-signed signature.
- A delta mapping showing which Archer profile fields map to Vendr owner/contact fields (owner email, role, steward).

What we need from you to proceed: 
1) Confirmation that Vendr can accept a manifest upload to the /proofs endpoint (we can also upload via your S3 staging bucket if that is preferred).
2) The portal account or service principal to use for a one-time ingest (minimal rights: read-only to the target upload prefix).
3) Any retention policy constraints (e.g., must keep proofs for 12 months) or hash-salting requirements.

I've attached a first-draft manifest (proof_manifest_v1.zip) and a short S3 upload checklist. Internal note: Rishi and Priyom — see the KMS rotation artifacts attached; we need to confirm the signing key id before creating the signed manifest.

Proposed timeline: upload & verification script to Julie by Mon 2026-04-12, portal ingest window Tue 2026-04-13.

Would you prefer we drop the manifest directly into Vendr or hand you a download link?

Thanks,

—Olga
Olga Petrov
Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.com
Attachment: proof_manifest_v1.zip (zip)
Attachment: s3_upload_instructions.pdf (pdf)

From: Julie Smith <julie.smith@acmehealth.com>

Cc: Vendr Support <support@vendr.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2026 11:37:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal proof-of-possession manifest & owner-mapping (Archer -> Vendr sync)

Hi Olga —

This looks good and aligned with what procurement asked for. A few clarifying items from our side before we confirm: 

- Can the manifest include per-file metadata: original path, timestamp, and an owner email? Procurement wants owner accountability per artifact.
- Our Vendr tenant supports both direct portal uploads and S3 staging; S3 staging is preferred for larger bundles. If you use S3 staging we'll provide temporary credentials scoped to the staging prefix.
- Retention: we require proofs to be retained for 18 months. After that they can be archived off-site.

One request: the signed manifest needs to include the KMS key fingerprint and a short statement of custody (one sentence) so legal can easily reference it in the contract addendum.

If you can resend with those items, we'll give you the staging bucket creds (temporary) for the ingest window on Tue 2026-04-13.

Thanks —
Julie
Julie Smith
Senior Security Program Manager, Acme Health
Attachment: none

Julie / Olga —

Thanks, good notes. Quick tech outline from our side: 

- The manifest we attached is a compressed bundle with entries shaped like: {path, sha256, mtime, owner_email}. We will add the KMS key fingerprint and the custody statement before finalizing.
- For signing, we'll use our customer-managed KMS key (key-id: redwood-prod-sig-archer-1). Priyom, please confirm that the key rotation log (kms_key_rotation_log.csv) matches the key-id we plan to use; if rotation occurred in the last 30 days we need to use the post-rotation key and include the previous fingerprint.
- For S3 staging: we will upload the zip to the staging prefix you share. Our upload script supports multipart and will emit a signed HEAD request that Vendr can use to validate the object after the fact.
- Minor privacy note: we will redact any PII from object-level metadata (owner_email will be company role emails where possible). 

Priyom — I put a small checklist in the runbook link that enumerates the exact fields Vendr will consume. Vendr support, can you confirm the staging prefix ACLs you prefer and whether we should set object ACL to private (yes) or public-read (no)?

Action items: 
- Priyom: confirm KMS key fingerprint and rotation row for redwood-prod-sig-archer-1 (by EOD 2026-04-12).
- Vendr Support: confirm staging prefix path + preferred ACL (ask for temp creds by EOD 2026-04-12).
- Olga: once we have creds we'll run a dry-run upload and share the verification results with Julie.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Staff Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
